shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Lift + neon rim on interactive card hover.

shadows.name: neon-purple-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary buttons and brand logo accent glow.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Save, add game, auth submit — purple fill with neon shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #a855f7; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4); transition: background 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7c3aed; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a855f7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Status toggles and secondary actions on cards.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; width: 100%; background: transparent; color: #e2e8f0; padding: 11px 14px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.28); border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.12); border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a855f7; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline__icon { color: #93c5fd; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Library search field with leading icon.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: #0f0f15; border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; transition: border-color 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #a855f7; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35); } .ds-search__icon { color: #94a3b8; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-search__input { flex: 1; background: transparent; border: none; color: #f8fafc; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; } .ds-search__input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; }

components.name: Genre Chip
components.description: Filter and metadata genre tags on game cards.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 12px; background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.16); color: #e9d5ff; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.28); border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Game Card
components.description: Signature collection card with cover, metadata, and status footer.
components.html:
PS5

Elden Ring

FromSoftware · 2022
components.css: .ds-game-card { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(24,24,42,0.98) 0%, rgba(15,15,28,0.98) 100%); border-radius: 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.14); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-game-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.45), 0 0 0 1px rgba(168,85,247,0.25); border-color: rgba(168,85,247,0.35); } .ds-game-card__cover { aspect-ratio: 3/4; background: #151520; position: relative; } .ds-game-card__platform { position: absolute; bottom: 12px; left: 12px; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(0,55,145,0.88); color: #fff; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-game-card__body { padding: 16px 18px 10px; } .ds-game-card__title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 700; color: #f8fafc; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-game-card__meta { margin: 0; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #c4b5fd; font-weight: 600; } .ds-game-card__footer { padding: 12px 18px 18px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.1); } .ds-game-card__status { width: 100%; background: rgba(59,130,246,0.12); color: #93c5fd; border: 1px solid rgba(59,130,246,0.35); border-radius: 12px; padding: 11px 14px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.25s ease; } .ds-game-card__status:hover { background: rgba(59,130,246,0.2); }

components.name: Header Brand
components.description: App header brand mark with Orbitron wordmark.
components.css: .ds-header { background: #12121a; padding: 16px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(168,85,247,0.2); } .ds-header__brand { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-header__name { font-family: Orbitron, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; color: #f8fafc; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-header__accent { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a855f7 0%, #06b6d4 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text; } .ds-header__tagline { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #94a3b8; font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview: GameVault is a power-user game library tool dressed in cyberpunk atmosphere. The interface behaves like Steam or GOG — dense metadata, fast filters, scannable grids — while the dark vault framing signals ownership of a personal collection. Design serves the task: users are cataloging, searching, and updating play state, not admiring chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Information-dense library views with platform badges, status chips, and inline stats
Inter for all UI copy; Orbitron reserved for brand wordmark and hero titles only
Purple-led accent with cyan/pink/green reserved for semantic status
WCAG AAA text contrast prioritized on body copy

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: Neon box-shadow and pulse animations appear only on hover, focus, or brand hero moments — never as a default resting state on every card.

rules.name: The Readable Dark Rule
rules.body: Body text and placeholders must meet WCAG AAA where practical (#cbd5e1 minimum on #151520). Muted gray (#64748b) is deprecated for readable copy.

rules.name: The Orbitron Gate
rules.body: Orbitron is forbidden on buttons, form labels, data tables, and navigation items. If it's not the brand name or a page hero, it's Inter.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows and glow appear as a response to hover, focus, or primary CTA — not on every container.

dos: Do use Inter for all UI text and Orbitron only for brand/display moments.
Do keep library views information-dense — metadata, filters, and stats visible without drilling in.
Do apply neon purple to primary actions and focus states; cyan/pink/green for semantic status only.
Do lift cards on hover (4px) with border intensification.
Do maintain AAA text contrast on body copy (#cbd5e1+) even when it softens neon accents.
donts: Don't use over-neon / RGB gamer cliché — constant glow, gradient text on every heading, pulsing borders as default decoration.
Don't use mobile free-to-play UI patterns — loot-box energy, cartoon chrome, loud gradient CTAs, fake urgency.
Don't ship spreadsheet ugly layouts — raw tables with no hierarchy, no scan path, no collection delight.
Don't fall into generic SaaS dashboard patterns — cream cards, hero metrics, eyebrow labels on every section.
Don't use gradient text except the single Vault brand span in the header.
Don't nest cards or use side-stripe borders on list items.
Don't put Orbitron on buttons, labels, or data-dense UI.
